description: This file defines the NextcloudAPI interface with methods to interact with Nextcloud notes via REST API, along with extension functions for note operations (get, create, update, delete, capabilities).

methods.name: getNotesCapabilities
methods.description: Fetches the notes capabilities from Nextcloud server using configured remote address and credentials.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by noteId from the Nextcloud server.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note on the Nextcloud server with provided ETag.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on the Nextcloud server.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID from the Nextcloud server.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes from the Nextcloud server.
